description: 12-year causal delay window mapped to a recurrence graph. Formation, neutral geometry, and recursive persistence are constructed from the same graph operator.

invariant_parameters.forecast_rule: AR12 plus a two-coefficient adaptive correction along (persistence-AR12); BFG feature is standardized neutral retention <D,C_N D>/<D,D>
invariant_parameters.matched_null_rule: same two-coefficient correction family, but driven by the calibration-selected ordinary window statistic

measurement_mapping.D: sigmoid-calibrated activity resource with phase from standardized level + i*local temporal gradient
measurement_mapping.K: normalized recurrence-graph Laplacian plus fixed offset minus one resource-supported rank-one formation mode
measurement_mapping.R_C: same graph eigenbasis: lowest fixed-rank modes have unit modulus phase; complement is contractive
measurement_mapping.Y: fixed-scale squared normalized graph Laplacian plus scalar resource-stress load; PSD and graph-aligned

name: Annual Sunspot BFG Carrier
